sectionDetails.dashboardOverview: Counts refresh from the local control-plane data and include every build and run.
sectionDetails.dashboardFeedbackTrends: Changing the range refreshes every chart; run status counts include succeeded, failed, cancelled, and running evaluations.
sectionDetails.iterationImprovementTrend: The chart uses the selected build and compares accepted feedback with the supervisor score for each recorded iteration.
sectionDetails.buildList: A build links reusable environments, runners, workflows, prompts, and test cases; changing an asset does not alter existing run evidence.
sectionDetails.assetProfiles: Profile secrets are read from the configured environment variable and are not stored in the browser.
sectionDetails.assetTemplates: Templates are versioned reusable instructions; selecting one in a build does not modify its saved source.
sectionDetails.assetTests: A test-case set supplies fixed prompts and acceptance evidence that runners can reuse across builds.
sectionDetails.assetRunners: Runners contain project-specific automation and can be shared by multiple builds.
sectionDetails.executionEnvironment: Choose local or remote execution details here; each runner uses the environment selected by its build.
sectionDetails.targetEnvironment: Repository, browser URL, and managed prompt path are used only by builds that select this target.
sectionDetails.applicationSettings: Language affects the console and manager-result display; theme changes are saved locally in this browser.
sectionDetails.applicationData: Changing the location affects future local state and evidence; existing data is not moved automatically.
sectionDetails.managerPrompt: A console-wide operating prompt, separate from reusable build templates.
sectionDetails.systemAiModel: This profile powers Orbit system features such as chat and cycle analysis, independently of a build's supervisor profile.
sectionDetails.orbitLogs: Entries are local operational events. They help diagnose console and runner activity but are not evaluation evidence.
